prompt:
Find real, published figures for the energy consumed per query (in Wh) by large language model chatbots. Cite the sources and quote the estimates they give.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
### Measured / published estimates for Wh per chatbot query

SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "optimized frontier-scale inference consumes sub-watt-hour energy per query (median 0.31 Wh, interquartile range [IQR] 0.16–0.60)" | CLAIM: Frontier-scale LLM inference under production conditions has median energy use of ~0.31 Wh per query (IQR 0.16–0.60 Wh).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "It also shows that high-profile public estimates and measurements based on non-production assumptions overstate energy use by 4–20×." | CLAIM: Non-production assumptions can inflate per-query energy estimates by a factor of ~4–20.
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "recent efficiency improvements in model design, serving systems, and hardware could together reduce energy use by 8–20×" | CLAIM: Combined model/serving/hardware efficiency gains may cut energy per query by ~8–20×.
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "Altman, S. (2025). The gentle singularity. Sam Altman Blog. https://blog.samaltman.com/the-gentle-singularity." | CLAIM: A public disclosure attributed to Sam Altman reports an average ChatGPT query energy of **0.34 Wh/query** (as tabulated in the paper; details like hardware/query mix are not provided).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "Elsworth, C. ∙ Huang, K. ∙ Patterson, D. ... Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google Scale" | CLAIM: A fleetwide Google measurement reports a “typical Gemini Apps request” energy of **0.24 Wh/query** (as tabulated in the paper).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "You, J. (2025). How much energy does ChatGPT use? Epoch AI. https://epoch.ai/gradient-updates/how-much-energy-does-chatgpt-use." | CLAIM: Epoch AI estimates a GPT‑4o query at **0.30 Wh** for ~500 output tokens (as tabulated in the paper).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "Jegham, N. ∙ Abdelatti, M. ∙ Koh, C.Y. ... How hungry is AI? Benchmarking Energy, Water, and Carbon Footprint of LLM Inference" | CLAIM: An estimate for GPT‑4o reports **0.42 Wh** per query (300 output tokens) based on API user-side throughput (as tabulated in the paper).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "de Vries, A. The growing energy footprint of artificial intelligence Joule. 2023; 7:2191-2194" | CLAIM: An older (2023) estimate for an “average ChatGPT query” reports **2.9 Wh/query** (as tabulated in the paper, noted as outdated/non-production conditions).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "median energy per query using FP8 reported as 0.21 Wh; average output tokens: 367" | CLAIM: ML.ENERGY Benchmark v3 measurement for Llama 3.1 405B reports **0.21 Wh/query** (FP8; ~367 output tokens).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "median energy per query for 4xH100 using BF16 reported as 0.04 Wh; assumed to be equivalent to 8xH100 using FP8; average output tokens: 361." | CLAIM: ML.ENERGY Benchmark v3 measurement for Llama 3.1 70B reports **0.04 Wh/query** (BF16; ~361 output tokens; with an FP8-equivalent assumption stated).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "reported for FP16 as 0.08 Wh/query; we approximate to FP8 as 0.08 Wh/1.7 = 0.05; 300 output tokens" | CLAIM: Caravaca et al. measurement for Llama 3.1 70B reports **0.08 Wh/query** in FP16, approximated to **~0.05 Wh/query** at FP8 (300 output tokens).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "reported for FP16 as 0.35 Wh/query; we approximate to FP8 as 0.35 Wh/1.7 = 0.21; 300 output tokens" | CLAIM: Caravaca et al. measurement for Llama 3.1 405B reports **0.35 Wh/query** in FP16, approximated to **~0.21 Wh/query** at FP8 (300 output tokens).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "AI Energy Score ... we adjusted for quantization as 1.72 Wh/1.7 = 1.01; non-production conditions, no batching, no serving engine" | CLAIM: AI Energy Score measurement for Llama 3.1 70B (non-production conditions) is adjusted to **~1.01 Wh/query** for quantization (as tabulated).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "IEA estimate ... Mixtral 8×22B ... ∼1.25" | CLAIM: IEA estimate for Mixtral 8×22B is **~1.25 Wh/query** under non-production conditions (as tabulated).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "IEA estimate ... DeepSeek-R1 ... ∼2.25" | CLAIM: IEA estimate for DeepSeek‑R1 is **~2.25 Wh/query** under non-production conditions (as tabulated).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "median energy per query for B200 using FP8; adjusted to H100 as 3.32 Wh × 2.8 = 9.30 ... average output tokens: 8,968" | CLAIM: ML.ENERGY Benchmark v3 measurement for DeepSeek‑V3 reports **9.30 Wh/query** after hardware adjustment (B200→H100), with very long outputs (~8,968 tokens).
SOURCE: https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00114-5 | QUOTE: "median energy per query for B200 using FP8; adjusted to H100 as 7.45 Wh × 2.8 = 20.9; average output tokens: 11,287" | CLAIM: ML.ENERGY Benchmark v3 measurement for DeepSeek‑R1 reports **20.9 Wh/query** after hardware adjustment (B200→H100), with very long outputs (~11,287 tokens).

### Additional supporting figures found

SOURCE: https://www.arxiv.org/pdf/2505.09598v3 | QUOTE: "A single short GPT-4o query consumes 0.42 Wh ( $\pm 0.13$ Wh)" | CLAIM: The arXiv paper reports **0.42 Wh ± 0.13 Wh** for a single short GPT‑4o query.
SOURCE: https://www.arxiv.org/pdf/2505.09598v3 | QUOTE: "For medium-length queries, this increases to 9.71 Wh ( $\pm 1.106$ Wh)." | CLAIM: The same paper reports **9.71 Wh ± 1.106 Wh** for medium-length GPT‑4o queries (daily pattern statement).
SOURCE: https://www.arxiv.org/pdf/2505.09598v3 | QUOTE: "exceeding the footprint of a Google search (0.30 Wh) by approximately 40%" | CLAIM: The paper compares a short GPT‑4o query (~0.42 Wh) with a Google search (~0.30 Wh).

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A single universally accepted Wh/query value across all chatbots and query types (published figures vary widely by model, serving setup, output length, and assumptions).
